description: Generate the Hermes home at install and stop tracking .hermes/: agro harness install hermes writes a typed YAML seed of the AGRO defaults into an absent <target-root>/.hermes/config.yaml, sets terminal.cwd, and git ignores the whole .hermes/ directory.

userStories.title: Seed the Hermes configuration defaults at install
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `agro harness install hermes` to write the AGRO Hermes defaults into `<target-root>/.hermes/config.yaml` so that a fresh checkout needs no tracked Hermes file.
acceptanceCriteria: When `<hermes_home>/config.yaml` does not exist before the call, `hermes_workspace_configure()` in `.agro/scripts/hermes-workspace.sh` writes the AGRO defaults to that path as one YAML seed. Then the function sets `terminal.cwd` through `hermes config set`.

The seed holds these keys and values: `model.default: gpt-6.1-sol-900k`, `model.provider: openai-codex`, `model.base_url: https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`, `compression.codex_gpt55_autoraise: false`, `compression.auto_compact_percent: 85`, and `onboarding.seen.profile_build_offered: true`.
The seed writes `auto_compact_percent` as a YAML integer and writes `codex_gpt55_autoraise` and `profile_build_offered` as YAML booleans.
The seed holds no `_config_version` key and no `terminal.cwd` key.
`.agro/scripts/hermes-workspace.sh` holds the seed in one list. No other tracked file holds a second copy of the values.
When `<hermes_home>/config.yaml` exists before the call, the function sets only `terminal.cwd`. The function writes no seed.

A new case in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/hermes-integration.test.ts` runs the configure step against an empty home with a stub `hermes` binary. The case parses `config.yaml` with the `yaml` package and asserts each seed key, the number type of `auto_compact_percent`, the boolean type of both boolean keys, and the absence of `_config_version`.
The same case asserts that the stub `hermes` binary receives `config set terminal.cwd <target-root>` after the seed write.

A second new case writes a `config.yaml` with operator values before the configure step. The case asserts that the file bytes are unchanged after the step and that the stub `hermes` binary receives only `config set terminal.cwd <target-root>`.
Both new cases fail before the change and pass after the change.

When the seed write fails, the function returns a non-zero exit status, leaves no partial `config.yaml`, and prints a message that names `<hermes_home>/config.yaml`. The function does not run `hermes config set` after a failed seed write.

Commits: ed8c77c9 (seed in configure), cd4b8970 (seed subcommand + seedHermes() before the installer on host and sandbox paths; advisor-directed repair because the upstream installer stage_config copies cli-config.yaml.example when config.yaml is absent).
AC1 executed: bash hermes-workspace.sh seed on empty home -> exit 0, config.yaml written; configure-path order covered by vitest case 1 (seeded marker precedes config set terminal.cwd).
AC2 executed: node+yaml parse of seeded file shows all six keys with expected values.
AC3 executed: typeof auto_compact_percent=number, codex_gpt55_autoraise=boolean, profile_build_offered=boolean.
AC4 executed: parsed seed has no _config_version and no terminal key.
AC5 executed: git grep gpt-6.1-sol-900k (excluding CHANGELOG/.agro/tasks) -> only hermes-workspace.sh seed array and one test assertion; tracked .hermes/config.yaml removed by US-002.
AC6 executed: seed on home with 'x: 1' -> exit 0, bytes unchanged; vitest case 2 asserts only config set terminal.cwd.
AC7-AC9 executed: pnpm exec vitest run hermes-integration, harness, gateway, hermes-links -> 189 passed, 2 skipped, exit 0.
AC10 reasoned: cases 1 and 3 were red before the change (worker evidence: 2 failed). Case 2 (existing config untouched) cannot be red because pre-change code already left config.yaml untouched; criterion wording defect, recorded as a lesson.

userStories.title: Remove `.hermes/` from git and ignore the whole directory
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want git to track no file under `.hermes/` so that runtime state and generated configuration stay out of the repository.
acceptanceCriteria: `git rm --cached` removes `.hermes/README.md` and `.hermes/config.yaml` from the index. `git ls-files .hermes` prints nothing.
`.gitignore` replaces the `/.hermes/*` block and its four `!` exemptions with the one line `/.hermes/`.
`git check-ignore -q .hermes/config.yaml .hermes/README.md .hermes/skills/agro` exits 0.
A new test in `.agro/scripts/__tests__/hermes-links.test.ts` runs `git ls-files .hermes` at the repository root and asserts empty output.

The `.hermes/README.md` content has a home in `docs/harnesses/hermes.md`. The page states that `HERMES_HOME` is `<target-root>/.hermes`, that the directory holds gitignored runtime state, and that the program lives at `~/.local/lib/hermes-agent`.
`docs/harnesses/hermes.md` states that `agro harness install hermes` generates `config.yaml` with the AGRO defaults on first install.
`docs/harnesses/hermes.md` tells an operator with local edits in `.hermes/config.yaml` to copy the file to a backup path before the operator pulls this change.
`CHANGELOG.md` holds one `### Removed` entry under `## [Unreleased]` for the removal of the tracked `.hermes/` files.
userStories.notes:
AC1 executed: git ls-files .hermes | wc -l -> 0 on integrated task branch (exit 0).
AC2 executed: git diff shows /.hermes/* and four ! exemptions replaced by /.hermes/.
AC3 executed: git check-ignore -q per path for .hermes/config.yaml, .hermes/README.md, .hermes/skills/agro -> exit 0 each. The three-path -q form exits 128 (git allows -q with one path only); criterion wording defect, intent met.
AC4 executed: pnpm exec vitest run hermes-links.test.ts standard-skills-link.test.ts -> 57 passed, 2 skipped, exit 0; worker showed the new case red before git rm --cached.
AC5 reasoned: docs/harnesses/hermes.md states HERMES_HOME=<target-root>/.hermes, gitignored runtime state, program at ~/.local/lib/hermes-agent.
AC6 reasoned: docs Install section states first install generates config.yaml with the AGRO defaults.
AC7 reasoned: docs subsection 'Back up an edited configuration before you pull' gives the backup steps.
AC8 executed: CHANGELOG.md has one ### Removed entry under [Unreleased] linking #1401.
Extra: link-providers.sh --check exit 0; ste-check on docs page 0 findings.

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a command transcript of a real Hermes install so that the PR `## Manual review` section proves the generated home.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/hermes-generated-home/evidence/manual-review.md` holds a transcript of `agro harness install hermes` in a sandbox with no `.hermes/config.yaml`.
The transcript shows `cat .hermes/config.yaml` with each seed key, `terminal.cwd`, and the `_config_version` value that Hermes writes.
The transcript shows a second `agro harness install hermes` after a manual `hermes config set model.default <other-model>`. The second run keeps `<other-model>`.
The transcript shows `git status --short .hermes` with empty output after both runs.
The transcript shows `ls -la .hermes/skills` with the link `agro -> ../../.agro/skills`.
The story uses a sandbox only with operator approval and deletes each resource that the story creates.
